guide: Open Start and type your center name and your own limits in the yellow cells: reply hours, the same-day report target, the first day of the term and entries each child needs.
Keep Children and Families up to date. Each family gets a room, and the Families sheet shows the last contact, the booked conference and the next event.
Add each daily report on Daily Reports: the room, the teacher and the time it was sent. The same-day share and the room tables fill in by themselves.
Log each parent message on Parent Messages with its topic and status only, never the content. Hours waiting and the reply-by date are calculated.
Plan the year on Newsletter and Event Plan, add events on Events and conference slots on Conferences. Conference Slots shows which slots are booked and which are free.
Add every observation or portfolio entry on Observations. Observation Status lists each enrolled child with the entries this term and a flag for children with none.
Enter each program week on Program Weeks: places, sign-ups, price a day and staff cost. The Camp Calendar shows the break-even sign-ups and a decision for each camp week.
Use Communication Gaps and the gap finder to call the families nobody has talked to for a long time.
Add every child who leaves on Children with an end date and a reason; Children Who Left shows months stayed and the tuition of a year.
Use the 18 calculators for reports, planning, observations, camp fill, minimum sign-ups, price, staffing, discounts and leavers.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Families and Camps Dashboard and Charts every week: reports, messages, conferences, observations, camp fill and leavers.

listing.title: Childcare Center Families, Programs and Camps Excel Template: Daily Reports, Parent Messages, Conferences, Camp Break-even, Leavers
listing.headline: Keep every family heard and know which camp weeks to run
listing.description:
Run the relationship with families and the camp programs of a home daycare or childcare center in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director with 1 to 5 rooms. Daily Reports show who sent each report and the share sent the same day by room and teacher; Parent Messages keeps the topic, the status and the hours a reply took, never the content. Families, Communication Gaps and a gap finder show who has not been called, and the conference sheets show held, booked and no-show status with free and booked slots.

Observation Status lists every enrolled child with the entries this term and flags children with none, counts and dates only. Program Weeks and the Camp Calendar give places, sign-ups, price a day, staff cost and the break-even sign-ups for before-after school, summer camp and holiday camp weeks, with a decision to run, run with a minimum or cancel.

18 calculators cover report tracking, the newsletter and event plan, observation status, camp fill, minimum sign-ups, price testing, staffing, discounts, reply time, conference slots, event attendance, leaver reasons and a family pulse score. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to families, teachers, floaters, the assistant director and the owner-director. Children's data is names, rooms, dates and status only.

This is part seven of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you keep track of families and camps and does not promise results.
features: Daily report tracker with same-day share by room and teacher
Parent messages by topic with reply time, status only
Communication gap finder for families nobody has called
Conference slots booked and free with no-show history
Observation status by child, counts and dates only
Camp break-even and run or cancel decision for every week
Camp minimum sign-ups finder, price tester and discount test
Leaver reasons with months stayed and tuition lost
Dashboard with 30 live figures and 22 charts

documents.title: Year-end letter for a family
paragraphs: Year-end letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. To {col:families.guardian} and the {col:families.family}.

Thank you for the time you spend with us. Your family started with us on {col:families.first_start}; you have {col:families.enrolled_kids} children enrolled now and have joined {col:families.conf_held} conferences.
Our next newsletter goes out on {col:families.news_date}. We wish you a calm and happy break and look forward to the new year together.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own center and check your own local rules.
